about: The invocation that closes the prayers of Leo XIII, added to them in 1904 under Pius X. It is said three times. This edition prints it once.

fn.w001: A neuter noun has one form for nominative and vocative. This edition tags the address as nominative, as it does in Agnus Dei.
fn.w002: Genitive dependent on “Cor”: the Heart of Jesus.
fn.w003: The superlative of “sacrátus”. It agrees with “Cor” (w001).

fn.w004: The imperative of a deponent verb: passive in form, active in meaning.
fn.w005: Dative dependent on “miserére”. In Classical Latin this verb usually takes the genitive.
